defs.def: (at) the present time 现在；目前；此刻

ex.s: Now I understand that although my son may be learning differently, he is still learning.
ex.t: 现在我明白，虽然儿子的学习方式可能不同，但他仍然在学习。

ex.s: Museums, once quiet places filled with history, are now full of digital excitement.
ex.t: 博物馆曾经是充满历史气息的安静场所，如今却处处洋溢着数字化的活力。

ex.s: To stay warm, she ran her engine for a few minutes every now and then.
ex.t: 为了保暖，她时不时把引擎发动几分钟。

ex.s: Panda Gourmet offers online ordering for takeout, and delivery is now an option.
ex.t: Panda Gourmet提供外卖在线点餐，现在也支持配送。

ex.s: The house is now listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
ex.t: 这座房子如今已被列入《国家史迹名录》。

ex.s: Simple readings are now readily available on our phones and wearables.
ex.t: 如今，我们的手机和可穿戴设备都能轻松给出这些简单读数。

ex.s: What started as an experiment is now more of a philosophy.
ex.t: 起初只是一次实验，如今更像一种理念。

ex.s: Now, Pereira has teamed up with plant scientist Professor Wolfgang Busch to apply SLEAP to plants.
ex.t: 现在，佩雷拉与植物学家沃尔夫冈·布施教授合作，将SLEAP应用于植物研究。

ex.s: I realise now that Mum didn’t find the joy in these tasks: she created it.
ex.t: 我现在才明白，妈妈并不是在这些任务中找到快乐：是她创造了快乐。

ex.s: “Plants are in fashion right now,” says Dr Melinda Knuth, a researcher from the University of Florida.
ex.t: “植物现在正流行，”佛罗里达大学的研究员Melinda Knuth博士说。

ex.s: You must leave right now!” he called out, holding the branch with both hands.
ex.t: “你必须现在就离开！”他双手抓着树枝喊道。

ex.s: “And as of right now, we’ve received about 120 submissions.
ex.t: “而截至目前，我们已经收到约120份投稿。”

ex.s: “At the end of the day all transit agencies right now are doing everything they can to improve the rider experience.
ex.t: “归根结底，现在所有公交机构都在竭尽所能改善乘客体验。

ex.s: She explains we are at a “tipping point” in history and must act now to prevent an extinction-level event for humanity.
ex.t: 她解释说，我们正处于历史上的一个“临界点”，必须立刻行动，以防人类遭遇灭绝级事件。

ex.s: For many of us, moderation means eating less than we do now.
ex.t: 对我们许多人来说，适量意味着吃得比现在少。

ex.s: Your “actual” self is how you are right now.
ex.t: 几天后，我带着第一批零浪费购物罐回来了，爸爸评论说我到处带着罐子有多傻。

ex.s: Now I’d been declared talentless.
ex.t: 现在我被认定没有天赋。

ex.s: Although I have enjoyed breaking my decades-long taboo about working with oil paints, I have discovered I now prefer chalks and ink.
ex.t: 虽然我很享受打破几十年来不用油画创作的禁忌，但我发现自己现在更喜欢粉笔和墨水。

ex.s: Now that we are in the information age, we have new concepts such as the computer, information processing, virtual reality, and simulation.
ex.t: 既然我们处于信息时代，我们就有了计算机、信息处理、虚拟现实和模拟等新概念。

ex.s: Now list all the characteristics you like about yourself.
ex.t: 现在列出你喜欢自己的所有特质。

ex.s: Now, write it again.” I wrote it again, and again and again.
ex.t: 现在，再写一遍。”我一遍又一遍地重写。

ex.t: 吉姆现在在哪里？

ex.s: How does Victor feel about his team now?
ex.t: 维克多现在对他的队伍感觉如何？

ex.s: “We have students who say they went home and talked to their parents and now they’re eating differently,” Jaramillo says.
ex.t: “我们有学生说，他们回家和父母谈过，现在他们的饮食方式不同了，”哈拉米略说。

ex.s: People now rarely have the patience to read.
ex.t: 如今人们很少有阅读的耐心。

ex.s: Pocket parks are now popular.
ex.t: 口袋公园现在很流行。

ex.s: Now, I’m living out that dream indirectly by helping the panda keepers do their job in English.
ex.t: 现在，我通过帮助熊猫饲养员用英语开展工作，间接实现了那个梦想。

ex.s: Now, write it again.” I wrote it again, and again and again.
ex.t: 现在，再写一遍。”我一遍又一遍地重写。

ex.s: From the age of six, Terri, now 26, accompanied Derek to work during her school holidays.
ex.t: 从六岁起，现年26岁的特丽就在学校放假期间陪德里克去干活。

ex.s: Though DIY has traditionally been seen as male hobby, the research shows it is women now leading the charge.
ex.t: 尽管DIY传统上被视为男性的爱好，但研究显示，如今是女性冲在最前面。

ex.s: For now, grizzlies remain listed.
ex.t: 目前，灰熊仍在保护名录上。

ex.s: Now, I’ve come to love those of small living things.
ex.t: 现在，我已经爱上了那些小小的生灵。

ex.s: Which is the percentage of the people using more diverse ingredients now?
ex.t: 现在使用更多样化食材的人占多大比例？

ex.s: A machine can now not only beat you at chess, it can also outperform you in debate.
ex.t: 机器现在不仅能在国际象棋上击败你，还能在辩论中胜过你。

ex.s: Conservation organizations put out pollinator-friendliness guidelines for home gardens, businesses, schools, cities—and now there are guidelines for solar farms.
ex.t: 保护组织发布了针对家庭花园、企业、学校和城市的传粉昆虫友好指南——现在也有了针对太阳能农场的指南。

ex.s: *Apply directly by clicking “Apply Now” button.
ex.t: *点击"Apply Now"按钮直接申请。

ex.s: As an award-winning cookbook author, Ms Young, now 66, has spent decades shopping the same way in New York’s Chinatown.
ex.t: 作为一位获奖食谱书作者，现年66岁的杨女士几十年来一直以同样的方式在纽约唐人街购物。

ex.s: Cruse now volunteers to help kindergarten students with reading two days a week, and on a third day, he instructs the school's first-and second-graders.
ex.t: 克鲁斯现在每周自愿花两天帮助幼儿园孩子阅读，第三天则指导学校的一、二年级学生。

ex.s: For Cruse, what started out as a way to kill time has now developed into a way to make a difference in the heart of a child.
ex.t: 对克鲁斯来说，最初打发时间的方式，如今已变成在孩子心灵中产生积极影响的方式。

ex.s: One paragraph down; now what?
ex.t: 一段写完了；现在呢？

ex.s: In recent years, researchers from diverse fields have agreed that short-termism is now a significant problem in industrialised societies.
ex.t: 近年来，来自不同领域的研究者一致认为，短视主义如今在工业化社会是一个重要问题。

ex.s: The historian Francis Cole argues that the West has entered a period where “only the present exists, a present characterised at once by the cruelty of the instant and by the boredom of an unending now”.
ex.t: 历史学家弗朗西斯·科尔认为，西方已进入一个"只有当下存在"的时期，这个当下同时以瞬间的残酷和无尽现在的无聊为特征。

ex.s: There are now 700 elderly people looking after hens in 20 care homes in the North East, and the charity has been given financial support to roll it out countrywide.
ex.t: 如今英格兰东北部20家养老院里有700名老人在照料母鸡，该慈善机构已获得财政支持，计划在全国范围内推广。

ex.s: Anyway, grandpa is now an internet star—two minutes of fame!
ex.t: 不管怎样，爷爷现在是个网络明星——两分钟的名气！

ex.s: Road accidents, which had fallen for years, are now rising sharply.
ex.t: 多年来一直在下降的交通事故，现在正急剧上升。

ex.s: Ever since her childhood, Ginni, now 71, has had a deep love for travel.
ex.t: 从童年时起，现年71岁的金妮就对旅行有着深厚的热爱。

ex.s: Engineers are now working on a new concept: the rail drones of the future.
ex.t: 工程师们正在研究一个新概念：未来的铁路无人机。

ex.s: Drinks now contain 45 million fewer kilos of sugar as a result of manufacturers' efforts to avoid the charge, according to Treasury analysis.
ex.t: 据英国财政部分析，由于制造商们努力规避糖税，饮料中的糖含量如今减少了4500万公斤。

ex.s: For nearly a decade now, Merebeth has been a self-employed pet transport specialist.
ex.t: 近十年来，梅雷贝斯一直是一名个体经营的宠物运输专家。

ex.s: The result—an approach known as systems thinking—is now seen as essential in meeting global challenges.
ex.t: 结果——一种被称为系统思维的方法——现在被视为应对全球挑战的关键。

ex.s: Now, big tech companies have invested in quantum computing, as have many smaller ones.
ex.t: 现在，大型科技公司已经在量子计算领域投入资金，许多小公司也是如此。

ex.s: “What’s new,” Johnson wrote, “is that millions of dollars are now potentially available to quantum computing researchers.”
ex.t: "新的变化是，"Johnson写道，"现在可能有数百万美元可用于量子计算研究人员。"

ex.s: The Sullivans now make about 1,500 toys each year to donate to local children’s charities, school districts and homeless shelters.
ex.t: 沙利文一家现在每年制作约1500件玩具，捐给当地的儿童慈善机构、学区和无家可归者收容所。

ex.s: The couple are now at work on the toys seven days a week, sometimes for 10 hours a day.
ex.t: 这对夫妇现在每周七天都在制作玩具，有时一天工作10个小时。

ex.s: The problem of robocalls has gotten so bad that many people now refuse to pick up calls from numbers they don't know.
ex.t: 骚扰电话的问题已经如此严重，以至于现在许多人拒绝接听来自陌生号码的电话。

ex.s: If you are planning to do exercise regularly, or you’re doing it now, then listen up!
ex.t: 如果你计划定期锻炼，或者你现在正在锻炼，那就听好了！

ex.t: 旅游业如今是道森市的主要产业——其目前人口为762人。

ex.t: 如果你现在从最高、最左边的点到最低、最右边的点画一条线，你就画出了一条预算线。

ex.t: 嗯，未来显然就是现在。

ex.s: Mac was pedaling hard now.

ex.s: Now she had friends.

ex.t: 我现在住在城里，我的送报员是一位叫埃德娜的女士，她有三个孩子。

ex.s: Some plants pump out smelly chemicals to keep insects away.But others do double duty .They pump out perfumes designed to attract different insects who are natural enemies to the attackers.Once they arrive,the tables are turned .The attacker who was lunching now becomes lunch.
ex.t: 一些植物释放出难闻的化学物质来驱赶昆虫。但另一些植物则一石二鸟。它们释放出特意设计的香气，以吸引不同种类的昆虫，而这些昆虫正是攻击者的天敌。一旦它们到来，局势便发生逆转。原本在进食的攻击者现在变成了食物。

ex.s: “I feel more confident in my actions now,” Taylor says.
ex.t: “我现在对自己的行为更有信心了，”泰勒说。

ex.s: Now, several states are moving to tighten laws by adding new regulations for opting out.
ex.t: 现在，几个州正通过为退出增加新规定来收紧法律。

ex.s: Now we have the most direct evidence yet that he is right.
ex.t: 现在我们有了最直接的证据证明他是对的。

ex.s: The music industry is developing fast now.
ex.t: 音乐产业现在发展迅速。

ex.s: However you start, remember there is no better time to start than right now, for you'll never be more alive than you are at this moment.
ex.t: 无论你如何开始，记住没有比现在更好的开始时间，因为你再也不会比此刻更有活力了。

ex.s: In Australia we now have over twenty million cars for just over twenty-six million people, among the highest rate of car ownership in the world.

ex.s: Now he hopes that other cities will consider making their streets run smarter instead of just making them bigger.
ex.t: 现在，他希望其他城市能够考虑让它们的街道变得更智能，而不仅仅是让它们变得更大。

ex.s: Fortunately, there's plenty of that happening right now, particularly the short-haul flights powered by batteries.
ex.t: 幸运的是，现在有很多这样的创新正在发生，特别是由电池驱动的短途航班。

ex.s: “But as I grew older,” Adeline says, "and missed my brother more and more, I realized that was the only thing we had left." Corrado Piccoli’s Purple Heart medal now hangs at the Italian American Civic Association in Watertown.
ex.t: "但随着年龄的增长，"阿德琳说，"而且我越来越想念我的哥哥，我才意识到这是我们唯一留下的东西。"科拉多·皮科利的紫心勋章现在挂在沃特敦意大利美国公民协会。

ex.s: "There is a lot of really interesting evidence which seems to be suggesting that if children are inspired up to the age of seven, then being outdoors will be a habit for life." His own children have got into the habit of playing outside now: "We just send them out into the garden and tell them not to come back in for a while."
ex.t: “有大量非常有趣的证据似乎表明，如果孩子在七岁前受到启发，那么待在户外将成为一生的习惯。”他自己的孩子现在也养成了在外面玩的习惯：“我们只是把他们赶到花园里，告诉他们一会儿别回来。”

ex.s: I should just   59   repeatedly having to say, ＂No We can’t go outside now.＂ Then when they come to other doors in life, be they real or metaphorical, they won’t   60   to open them and walk through.
ex.t: 我应该只是____59____反复说“不，我们现在不能出去。”然后当他们在生活中遇到其他门时，无论是真实的还是比喻意义上的，他们都不会____60____去打开并穿过。

ex.s: Recently，I conceptualized a new approach to timekeeping that's connected to circumstances on our planet，conditions that might change as a result of global warming．We're now building a clock at the Anchorage Museum that reflects the total flow of several major Alaskan rivers，which are sensitive to local and global environmental changes．We've programmed it to match an atomic clock if the waterways continue to flow at their present rate．If the rivers run faster in the future on average，the clock will get ahead of standard time．If they run slower，you'll see the opposite effect．
ex.t: 最近，我构想了一种与地球环境状况相关的新计时方法，而这些状况可能因全球变暖而改变。我们现在正在安克雷奇博物馆建造一座时钟，它反映阿拉斯加几条主要河流的总流量，这些河流对地方和全球的环境变化十分敏感。我们已对它编程：如果水道继续以目前速率流动，它就与原子钟同步；如果未来河流平均流速加快，时钟就会跑在标准时间前面；如果变慢，则会出现相反效果。

ex.s: But now it looks as if Arctic lakes are disappearing a century sooner than predicted.
ex.t: 但现在看来，北极湖泊消失的时间比预测的要早一个世纪。

ex.s: Now, I'm happy to tell people I feel shy.
ex.t: 现在，我很高兴地告诉别人我感到害羞。

ex.s: What is the woman's feeling now?
ex.t: 这位女士现在感觉如何？

ex.s: ●Now that you’ve listed your strengths, list your imperfections.
ex.t: 既然你已经列出了自己的优点，现在就列出你的缺点吧。

ex.t: 这位女士现在感觉如何？

ex.s: Where does the woman work now?
ex.t: 这位女士现在在哪里工作？

ex.s: “I know I was really lucky,” Paris says now.
ex.t: “我真幸运，”帕里斯现在说。

ex.s: But it's worth remembering that the banking system that we now all live with is just that: A modern invention.
ex.t: 但值得记住的是，我们现在赖以生存的银行体系不过如此：一种现代发明。

ex.s: For those who hunger for some peace and quiet, sound can now create silence.
ex.t: 对于那些渴望安宁与清静的人来说，声音现在可以创造寂静。

defs.def: at or from this moment, but not before 现在；从现在开始

ex.s: The woman should work harder from now on if she wants to get the job.
ex.t: 如果她想得到这份工作，就应该从现在起更加努力工作。

ex.s: Policymakers should start thinking now about how to make sure the appearance of driverless vehicles doesn’t extend the worst aspects of the car-controlled transportation system we have today.
ex.t: 政策制定者现在就应该开始思考，如何确保无人驾驶车辆的出现不会放大我们今天这种以汽车为主导的交通体系中最糟糕的方面。

ex.s: From now on I will only be editing articles for PsyBlog while wearing a white coat to help keep the typing error count low.
ex.t: 从现在起，我只会在穿着白大褂的情况下编辑PsyBlog的文章，以帮助减少打字错误的数量。

ex.s: The world has always had influential people, for instance, but only now do we have “Influencer”.
ex.t: 例如，世界上一直都有有影响力的人，但只是到了现在，我们才有了“网红”这个词。

ex.s: To us, now, the fence seems to be nothing but an impediment.
ex.t: 对我们现在来说，这道栅栏似乎只不过是个障碍。

ex.s: But now is the time to set the record straight, which starts with questioning the idea that all social comparison is unhealthy.
ex.t: 但现在是纠正错误认知的时候了，而这要从质疑"所有社会比较都不健康"这种观点开始。

ex.s: This is why Campbell has set out to raise awareness of AI and its future now — several decades before these developments are expected to take place.
ex.t: 这就是为什么坎贝尔现在就开始提高人们对人工智能及其未来的认识——比这些发展预计发生的时间早了几十年。

ex.s: The image of the reader appears throughout history, in art made long before books as we now know them came into being.
ex.t: 读者的形象贯穿整个历史，出现在远早于我们今天所熟知的书籍诞生之前的艺术作品中。

ex.s: The Caribbean Taino, the Australian Aboriginals, the African people of Benin and the Incas, all of whom appear in this book, can speak to us now of their past achievements most powerfully through the objects they made: a history told through things gives them back a voice.
ex.t: 加勒比地区的泰诺人、澳大利亚原住民、贝宁的非洲人和印加人——他们都出现在这本书中——如今可以通过他们制作的物件最有力地对我们讲述他们过去的成就：通过物讲述的历史让他们重获声音。

ex.s: Now a team of researchers led by Damián Blasi at the University of Zurich, Switzerland, has found how and why this trend arose.
ex.t: 如今，由瑞士苏黎世大学的达米安·布拉西领导的研究团队，发现了这一趋势产生的方式和原因。

ex.s: Fortunately for those in midlife, Levine is finding that even if you haven't been an enthusiastic exerciser, getting in shape now may help improve your aging heart.
ex.t: 对那些中年人来说幸运的是，莱文发现，即使你一直不是热衷锻炼的人，现在开始健身也可能有助于改善你衰老的心脏。

ex.s: Now, Cao has started the second part of his dream to walk along the Belt and Road route.
ex.t: 现在，曹已经开始了他梦想的第二部分——沿着一带一路路线行走。

ex.s: Looking back, I now see that this would be the first in a series of timely opportunities that my old self would have let pass, but that this new and more confident Alice enthusiastically seized.
ex.t: 回想起来，我现在看到，这将是我以前的自我本来会放弃的一系列及时机会中的第一个机会，但是这个新的和更加自信的爱丽丝却热情地抓住了机会。

ex.s: But now they are out of breath and sweating.
ex.t: 但现在他们上气不接下气，满头大汗。

ex.s: They are now getting a head start on next year’s toy workload.
ex.t: 他们现在已经开始着手准备明年的玩具制作工作了。

ex.s: Many people now misunderstand emotional intelligence as almost everything desirable in a person's makeup that cannot be measured by an IQ test, such as character, motivation, confidence, mental stability, optimism and "people skills." Research has shown that emotional skills may contribute to some of these qualities, but most of them move far beyond skill-based emotional intelligence.
ex.t: 现在许多人把情商误解为一个人特质中几乎所有无法用智商测试衡量的可取之处，比如性格、动力、自信、心理稳定、乐观和“人际技巧”。研究表明，情绪技能可能有助于其中一些品质，但大多数远远超出了基于技能的情商。

ex.s: But the stove was a mess now.
ex.t: 但炉子现在一片狼藉。

ex.s: But the stove was a mess now.
ex.t: 但炉子现在一片狼藉。

ex.s: It used to be that you  drive for miles here without seeing another person, but now there are houses and people everywhere.
ex.t: 过去在这里你可以开车数英里看不到一个人但现在到处都是房子和人。

ex.s: In the beginning，I dared myself to make a difference in the life of another person．Now that our project is over，I realize that I have affected not only one life，but ten．With our efforts，ten young boys and girls will now be able to further their education．
ex.t: 一开始我鼓起勇气想要改变另一个人的生活。现在我们的项目结束了，我意识到我影响的不只是一个生命，而是十个。通过我们的努力，十个年轻人现在将能够继续接受教育。

ex.s: We were raised on books and computers, highways and cell phones, but now we were living in a village without running water or electricity It was easy for us to go to sleep at the end of the day feeling a little misunderstood.
ex.t: 我们是在书本、电脑、高速公路和手机的环境中长大的，但现在却住在一个没有自来水和电的村庄。一天结束时，我们带着一点不被理解的感觉入睡是很容易的事。

ex.s: From now on, I started to play my football with classmates after school.
ex.t: 从那时起，我开始放学后和同学们一起踢足球。

ex.s: But it was now getting real dark． If I kept going I might not be able to see my way back． My mum would be worried sick if I didn't come home soon． So I ran back home almost in the dark while trying not to get too scared．
ex.t: 但天这会儿真的黑了。如果我继续走，可能看不清回去的路。如果我不快点回家，妈妈会担心死的。所以我几乎是摸黑跑回家，努力不让自己太害怕。

ex.s: Now all that was needed were the parents, but they were absent.
ex.t: 现在唯一需要的是父母，但他们不在场。

ex.s: You might think that developing nations would make up the loss (especially since 80% of the world’s people now live in such nations), but you’d be wrong.
ex.t: 你可能以为发展中国家会弥补这一损失（特别是既然世界上80%的人现在生活在这样的国家），但你错了。

ex.s: He's always had a square jaw, but now he's grown a beard.
ex.t: 他一直有一个正方形的下巴，但现在他长了一个胡子。

ex.s: Mum says I had cute rosy cheeks, but now I have freckles.
ex.t: 妈妈说我以前有可爱的红润脸颊，但现在长了雀斑。

ex.s: Most people have left work to go home, and this part of the city is now quiet.
ex.t: 大多数人已经下班回家，城市的这一部分现在很安静。

ex.s: Now I go dipping almost every day, and I’ve come to long for that moment when the cold becomes a second skin and my internal voice goes silent.
ex.t: 现在我几乎每天都去泡冷水浴，并开始渴望那一刻：寒冷变成第二层皮肤，我内心的声音归于沉寂。

ex.s: He pulled in front of it as the wolf was catching up fast, just a dozen yards away now.
ex.t: 他冲到那辆车前面，这时狼正在快速逼近，只有十几码远了。

defs.def: （改变话题或要对方做某事前，引起对方注意）喂，哎，嗨

ex.s: A ground-breaking, five-year study shows that diet-related changes in human bite led to new speech sounds that are now found in half the world’s languages.
ex.t: 一项开创性的五年研究表明，与人类咬合相关的饮食变化导致了新的语音，如今这些语音存在于世界上一半的语言中。

defs.def: （提出建议或提供帮助）喂，听我说

ex.s: It’s about the now and what one contributes to the now, because reading is a give and take between author and reader.
ex.t: 它关乎当下，以及一个人对当下的贡献，因为阅读是作者与读者之间的一种互动交流。

ex.s: "With our study, we think we can now confidently conclude that at least some dogs can distinguish human facial expressions," Muller told Live Science.
ex.t: "对我们来说最可能的解释是基础在于它们与人类的生活这给了它们大量接触人类面部表情的机会，"穆勒说而这种接触为它们提供了许多学习区分的机会。

ex.t: 当老师建议他们的孩子阅读杂志时，家长常常感到惊讶。

ex.s: New evidence suggests, however, that rainfall — particularly increasing autumn rain — is now contributing significantly to permafrost loss.
ex.t: 然而，新的证据表明，降雨——尤其是日益增多的秋雨——如今正在显著加剧永久冻土的消融。

ex.s: Now, more evidence has been provided that dogs distinguish between similar actions associated with different intentions.
ex.t: 现在有更多证据表明，狗能够区分与不同意图相关的相似行为。

ex.s: What do we know about the records of species collected now?
ex.t: 关于现在收集到的物种记录，我们知道什么？

ex.s: Now I was paying the price — to write a five-page essay on “Why I Should Not Talk in Class”.
ex.t: 现在我付出了代价——要写一篇五页的文章，题目是"我为什么不该在课堂上讲话"。

ex.t: 以海平面作为海拔参照点的想法如今已存在如此之久，以至于几乎被人忽视——我们提到它时甚至不去思考它的含义。

ex.s: Now we live in a world surrounded by the "can't do" attitudes． We all fall down． We all have doubts and regrets． Still we must climb and dream about what's at the top of our mountain． Monsters may appear or the night will fall． But never ever give up on your dream!
ex.t: 如今我们生活在一个被“做不到”态度包围的世界。我们都会跌倒。我们都有疑虑和悔恨。但我们仍须攀登，梦想山顶的风景。怪物可能出现，夜幕可能降临。但永远不要放弃你的梦想！

ex.s: Yet， now that I'm growing and the world I once knew as being so simple is becoming more complex， I find myself needing a way to escape． By opening a novel， I can leave behind my burdens and enter into a wonderful and mysterious world where I am now a new character． In these worlds I can become anyone． I don't have to write down what happened or what technique the author was using when he or she wrote this． I just read to relax．
ex.t: 然而，随着我渐渐长大，曾经以为如此简单的世界变得越来越复杂，我发现自己需要一种逃避的方式。打开一本小说，我就能抛开烦恼，进入一个奇妙而神秘的世界，在那里我成为一个新的角色。在这些世界里我可以成为任何人。我不必记下发生了什么，也不必分析作者写作时运用了什么技巧。我阅读只是为了放松。
